title: CLO 2026.0 New Features Highlights Video - Make it, for real!
description:
CLO 2026.0 New Feature Highlights Video Released!  
CLO technical experts guide you through the new feature highlights: Virtual Model 3D Line Drawing Pen, Panel Generator | Automatic Generation of Measurement Points and Grading, Strain Maps Based on Fabric Properties, Strap Threading, Bonding... Core functions upgraded again, reshaping the entire process from inspiration to garment!  
Born for realism, bringing inspiration directly to reality—start the new era of virtual fashion with CLO, make it, for real!
transcript:
Welcome to Kolo 2026.0.  
In this version, we will once again enhance your digital experience and efficiency through a series of new functions.  

First is the new integrated function.  
In addition to the conventional sewing, you can now connect the panels using the integrated tool.  
The software provides three flexible operating methods.  
Fast integration is used for the integration of internal patterns and panels.  
Brush integration is convenient for you to smear a specific area of integration.  
Fill-in integration can be realized quickly.  
The complete panel is integrated into another panel.  
This update will enhance the production accuracy of sportswear, outdoor clothing, and shoes.  

In terms of creative expression,  
The 3D virtual model line sketching process  
has become more efficient.  
You can now directly hook the draft on the model,  
and convert these drafts directly into panels.  
After completing the draft drawing,  
convert to 3D brush to continue editing and adjusting.  
Or you can also flatten the draft into panels.  
The system will automatically arrange and sew,  
letting inspiration quickly become a real clothing structure.  

Then there is the automatic tie-dye string function.  
Now you can quickly add a belt effect to the clothing or bag strap.  
The operation is very intuitive.  
You can not only easily complete a complex string path,  
but also create a corresponding strap version,  
and edit and adjust at any time according to design needs.  

The hardware display has also been upgraded.  
When checking the distribution of hardware,  
you can freely switch between universal and fabric modes.  
When choosing the universal mode,  
no matter what kind of fabric is used,  
as long as the value reaches 120% or higher,  
the area will be displayed in red.  
After switching to the fabric mode,  
the color range will be customized according to the physical properties of the fabric.  
This can help you scientifically evaluate the harmony of clothing according to different fabric properties.  

We have made many updates to the version generator.  
As usual,  
you can enter the CSV file or input the value directly,  
quickly and easily adding the measurement values.  
Now you can also directly enter the code information.  
You only need to add the code specifications,  
then pass the code rules,  
or directly enter the measurement value of each size to complete.  
The measurement value of each size can be entered repeatedly.  
After generating the version,  
the system will automatically arrange the version and sew it on the model.  
At the same time,  
all measurement points will automatically be applied to the measurement point option card of the object window.  
If you set the code,  
the relevant specifications will be synchronized.  
As long as the version is created using the version generator,  
you can return to the tool to continue editing at any time.  
Or you can also directly use the measurement point tool in the 2D window to modify the measurement value.  

Our measurement point calculator function can help you  
perform a variety of combination calculations for measurement points.  
You only need to click on the calculator icon,  
add the required measurement point values to the calculator.  
You can carry out basic mathematical operations.  
You can choose to store these mathematical formulas in the computing department,  
making it easy to check.  
You can see the calculation results in different size numbers,  
and apply these newly generated mathematical formulas to the item window measurement point list.  

In addition, in the attribute editor,  
you can also check all the calculations involved with the measurement points at any time.  

In this update,  
you can lock custom measurements on the map or outside of the version.  
You can also create a custom measurement point within the map,  
and accurately set the starting location in the attribute editor,  
achieving precise map positioning.  

In Clo 2026.0,  
applying irregular numbers becomes more efficient.  
Now you just need to press the Shift key,  
select multiple units, and multiply to modify the values at the same time,  
without affecting other size numbers.  

Under the arrangement settings,  
you can now choose the same clothes with the same orientation.  
This ensures that all versions of the same clothes are in the same direction.  
When your arrangement task involves multiple directions of cutting,  
this function will be very useful.  

Clo 2026.0 adds a new isolation selection to check the options.  
It will automatically hide all unselected parts,  
making it easier for you to observe the interior of the clothes,  
or view from angles that are usually difficult to observe and operate on.  

Finely adjust.  
We have improved the rendering function of the style map.  
Now it supports the measurement point and the sticker while rendering the style map.  
You can not only see these measurement points directly,  
but also use the measurement point selection card of the object window.  
You can choose the specific measurement value you want to display,  
and directly adjust the size in the style map window.  

For hair performance, we have also improved the depth.  
Now when you apply a sticker to the hair material,  
the system will automatically generate a cover and remove the hair in the area,  
ensuring that the sticker can be clearly displayed.  
In addition, you can also use the edit sewing tool  
to define the hair effect of the seam area.  
This allows accurate control of the hair thickness near the seam line,  
to determine the visibility of the seam area.  

To continue providing an optimized experience for Closet users,  
we redesigned the content page and workroom interface in Closet.  
When 3D files are uploaded to Closet,  
the first page the user sees is the cover section.  
You can fill in the main information through the text below,  
for example, the category.  
Click on the settings button in the upper right corner,  
you can define the content displayed on the first page.  
You can check the details in the purple label page on the right,  
such as details, file version, and linked content.  

The next part is the viewfinder.  
We have made many improvements to the 3D viewfinder,  
including the first option on the switch bar.  
Users can now use the Closet high-quality rendering in the 3D viewfinder.  
Click on it.  
Click on the label page in the upper right corner.  
Users can check the label and color labels separately.  
Click on the toolbar on the left,  
users can manage the version of the upload.  

The next section is the BOM material list.  
It will display the corresponding material list according to the settings in Closet.  
Users can also add blank lines to fill in new material information created in the Closet software before upload.  
Click on each part of the material list table,  
edit each material data.  

Next to the material list is the POM measurement point section.  
Similar to the previous one, it will display the measurement point data according to the settings in Closet.  

In the attached section,  
users can upload other relevant articles.  

The final content analysis will show the creation period of the model.  
Users can click on the button in the upper right corner to share and comment.  
Users can also check the activity date next to the comment.  

Finally, users can click on the personal image icon  
to change the theme to dark mode.  

If users return to the workstation level,  
you can click on the button in the style corner to preview relevant information.  

Through the above updates,  
users can enjoy a smoother collaboration experience in the design development process.  

Thank you for watching.  
To learn more about the new features and updates of Closet 2026.0,  
please visit our official website clo3d.com.

chunks.content: ## Introduction to CLO 2026.0 New Features This section introduces the key enhancements in CLO 2026.0 designed to improve digital garment design, production accuracy, and user workflow. Key terms include integrated function, 3D virtual model line sketching, automatic tie-dye string, hardware display modes, version generator, measurement point calculator, and Closet platform updates. --- ## Integrated Function for Panel Connection CLO 2026.0 introduces a new integrated function that complements traditional sewing by enabling panel connections through three flexible methods: - **Fast Integration:** For quickly integrating internal patterns and panels. - **Brush Integration:** Allows selective smearing of specific areas for integration. - **Fill-in Integration:** Quickly integrates entire panels into others. This function improves production accuracy for sportswear, outdoor clothing, and footwear by ensuring precise panel connections. --- ## Enhanced 3D Virtual Model Line Sketching The 3D virtual model line sketching process is now more efficient with direct draft hooking on the 3D model. Users can: - Convert drafts directly into panels. - Switch to a 3D brush mode for further editing and adjustment. - Flatten drafts into panels for automatic arrangement and sewing. This feature accelerates the transformation from design inspiration to real clothing structure. --- ## Automatic Tie-Dye String Function A new automatic tie-dye string tool enables quick addition of belt effects to clothing or bag straps. It supports: - Complex string path creation with intuitive control. - Generation of corresponding strap versions. - Real-time editing and adjustments based on design needs. This function streamlines strap design and customization. --- ## Upgraded Hardware Display Modes The hardware display feature now supports two modes for evaluating hardware distribution on garments: - **Universal Mode:** Highlights areas in red when the hardware value reaches 120% or more, regardless of fabric type. - **Fabric Mode:** Customizes color ranges based on the physical properties of specific fabrics. These modes assist in scientifically assessing clothing harmony relative to fabric characteristics. --- ## Version Generator Improvements Significant updates enhance the version generator's flexibility and efficiency: - Input measurement values via CSV file, direct value entry, or by entering code specifications. - Use code rules to automate version creation, with repetitive size measurement entries supported. - Automatic arrangement and sewing of generated versions on the 3D model. - Measurement points sync automatically with the measurement point option card in the object window. - Editable versions at any time via the version generator or the 2D window’s measurement point tool. These enhancements simplify multi-size version creation and modification workflows. --- ## Measurement Point Calculator and Attribute Editor The measurement point calculator allows users to: - Perform combination calculations on measurement points using basic math operations. - Store formulas in a computing department for easy reference. - View results across different sizes. - Apply calculated formulas directly to the item window’s measurement point list. Additionally, the attribute editor provides real-time access to all calculations involving measurement points, facilitating precise measurement management.

chunks.content: These enhancements simplify multi-size version creation and modification workflows. --- ## Measurement Point Calculator and Attribute Editor The measurement point calculator allows users to: - Perform combination calculations on measurement points using basic math operations. - Store formulas in a computing department for easy reference. - View results across different sizes. - Apply calculated formulas directly to the item window’s measurement point list. Additionally, the attribute editor provides real-time access to all calculations involving measurement points, facilitating precise measurement management. --- ## Custom Measurement Point Locking and Positioning CLO 2026.0 enables locking of custom measurements either on the map or outside the version. Users can: - Create custom measurement points within the map. - Precisely set the starting location of these points via the attribute editor. This ensures accurate positioning and control of custom measurements. --- ## Efficient Application of Irregular Numbers Applying irregular numbers has been optimized: - Users can press the Shift key to select multiple units simultaneously. - Multiply to modify values across selected units without affecting other size numbers. This feature speeds up uneven size adjustments. --- ## Arrangement Settings for Consistent Orientation A new arrangement setting allows choosing the same garment versions with consistent orientation, ensuring: - All versions of the same garment are aligned in the same direction. - Useful for arrangement tasks involving multiple cutting directions. This improves workflow consistency in pattern cutting. --- ## Isolation Selection for Interior Observation The new isolation selection feature automatically hides all unselected parts, enabling: - Clear observation of garment interiors. - Easier viewing from otherwise difficult angles. - Simplified operation on internal garment components. This enhances precision in garment inspection and editing. --- ## Style Map Rendering and Measurement Point Integration Rendering functions for the style map have been improved to support: - Display of measurement points and stickers directly on the style map. - Use of the measurement point selection card in the object window to choose specific measurement values. - Direct size adjustments within the style map window. This allows finer control and visualization of measurement data during styling. --- ## Hair Material and Sticker Interaction Enhancements Hair performance rendering has been enhanced: - Applying stickers to hair materials now automatically generates a cover that removes hair in the sticker area for clear visibility. - The edit sewing tool can define hair effects near seam areas, controlling hair thickness and seam visibility precisely. These improvements facilitate better visual integration of hair and garment elements. --- ## Redesigned Closet Content Page and Workroom Interface CLO 2026.0 features a redesigned Closet platform interface for smoother collaboration: - **Cover Section:** Displays main information like category, customizable via the settings button. - **Purple Label Page:** Shows details such as file version and linked content. - **3D Viewfinder:** Supports Closet’s high-quality rendering with separate label and color label viewing; version management via toolbar. - **BOM Material List:** Displays materials based on Closet settings; supports adding/editing materials before upload. - **POM Measurement Point Section:** Shows measurement point data per settings.

chunks.content: --- ## Redesigned Closet Content Page and Workroom Interface CLO 2026.0 features a redesigned Closet platform interface for smoother collaboration: - **Cover Section:** Displays main information like category, customizable via the settings button. - **Purple Label Page:** Shows details such as file version and linked content. - **3D Viewfinder:** Supports Closet’s high-quality rendering with separate label and color label viewing; version management via toolbar. - **BOM Material List:** Displays materials based on Closet settings; supports adding/editing materials before upload. - **POM Measurement Point Section:** Shows measurement point data per settings. - **Attached Section:** Allows upload of related articles. - **Content Analysis:** Displays model creation period, sharing, commenting, and activity dates. - **Theme Switching:** Users can toggle between light and dark modes via the personal image icon. - **Workstation Preview:** Accessible from the style corner button for relevant information preview. These updates enhance usability and collaborative workflows in the design development process. --- ## Summary CLO 2026.0 introduces comprehensive feature upgrades across pattern integration, 3D sketching, measurement management, rendering, and the Closet collaboration platform. These improvements are aimed at increasing design efficiency, accuracy, and collaboration quality in garment production workflows.
